label: Drape background
desc: A cloth-like backdrop of soft folds that the pointer sweeps through or you grab and drag, then springs back; static folds on touch and reduced motion.
use: Behind a landing hero or sign-in panel (put it first inside a position:relative section).

label: Wheel picker
desc: An iOS-style 3D wheel for choosing one value: drag or flick with inertia, mouse wheel, arrow keys and typeahead, snaps to a row.
use: Pick a time, day, plan or quantity in a booking form, settings page or dashboard filter.

label: Plucked text
desc: Text with a string under it: hover, drag or press Enter on the string and it vibrates while the letters ripple along.
use: A playful headline on a landing page, an empty state or a 404 page.

label: Pull cord
desc: A hanging cord with a handle: drag it down past a threshold and release (or press Enter/Space) to toggle; the cord stretches and swings back.
use: A theme or lamp switch in a header or landing hero, or any on/off setting with some character.

label: Activity terrain
desc: A small isometric terrain of bars (like a contribution grid) that you drag sideways or arrow-key to rotate, with a tooltip on hover and focus.
use: Dashboard activity overview, a profile page, or a publishing-frequency panel.

label: Liquid gauge
desc: A circle or tank gauge filled with two animated waves at the value; drag sideways to slosh the liquid. Exposed as role=meter.
use: Storage, quota or progress on a dashboard or connect page.
